input_requirement: If the glass break detector of a window detects the pane has been damaged, the system shall inform the security service within 2 seconds at the latest.

ambiguities.explanation: The phrase 'at the latest' creates ambiguity regarding the exact timing boundary. It is unclear whether the 2-second window is inclusive (the action must complete by the 2-second mark) or exclusive (the action must complete before the 2-second mark).
possible_interpretations: The system must inform the security service no later than the 2-second mark (inclusive).
The system must inform the security service before the 2-second mark (exclusive).

contextual_resolubility_analysis.validation_summary: The ambiguity regarding the timing boundary (inclusive vs. exclusive) is resolved by the explicit constraint defining the notification window.
